# Public IP Unreachable / NAT Rule Counter Never Increments / NAT Matches but Policy Does Not

Likely areas:

- ISP routing
- WAN addressing
- Proxy ARP
- Upstream route

Likely areas:

- Wrong incoming zone
- Wrong public IP
- Wrong port
- Wrong protocol
- Rule order
- Traffic never reaches SRX

Likely areas:

- Wrong destination zone
- Wrong translated destination object
- Wrong application
- Policy order
